title: Tagged uploads get public galleries
summary:
Tagged media galleries and clearer model-speed comparisons arrived alongside a substantial round of image-routing repairs.

Media uploads gained optional tags and public, paginated galleries; untagged files remain unlisted. Owners can delete tagged uploads, the upload limit rose from 50 MB to 100 MB, and SDK upload tags and runnable API examples were added. Uploads now get unique URLs rather than deduplicated, content-addressed ones.

Model Monitor gained a sortable tokens-per-second column and a table that scrolls with the page. A daily Discord leaderboard ranks community text models by tokens served, with a separate panel for the three fastest qualifying models.

Merged GPT Image routing changes use dedicated resources per model and retry eligible upstream failures, reducing the chance that one resource problem affects every image model. The fixes also distinguish resource blocks from prompt rejections, reject unsupported transparency requests for `gpt-image-2`, and update its supported-parameter docs. FLUX.2 Klein received a backend routing change.

daily.title: Public media tag galleries
daily.text: Tag uploads to publish them in browsable, paginated galleries, or leave them untagged and accessible only by URL. Uploads can be up to 100 MB, and the SDK accepts upload tags. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Compare model speed
daily.text: Model Monitor has a sortable Speed column showing completion tokens per second, so you can compare throughput alongside model health. [Open Model Monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Community model leaderboard
daily.text: A daily pixel-art leaderboard in Discord ranks community text models by tokens served over 24 hours, with a separate panel for the fastest qualifying models. [Visit community chat](https://chat.pollinations.ai).
